item.title: These deer walk 300 miles a year. The race is on to save their migration
item.description: Mule deer in Wyoming make some of the longest land migrations in the lower 48 states. They're trying to adapt to a changing climate, but growing development could stand in their way.
item.dc:creator: Lauren Sommer

item.title: COP31 ends with no deal after negotiators fail to reach an agreement on fossil fuels
item.description: International climate talks in Turkey ended in disappointment with countries failing to reach agreement over fossil fuels -- the primary driver of climate change.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Waldholz

item.title: Climate policy analyst on the failed negotiations at COP31
item.description: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with climate policy analyst Alden Meyer about why negotiators at COP31 failed to reach an agreement.
item.dc:creator: Michel Martin

item.title: Climate change talks fall apart in final hours over fossil fuels
item.description: Some 200 countries gathered in Antalya, Turkey, for COP31, the annual climate negotiations. Countries failed to reach an agreement over fossil fuels - the primary driver of global warming.
item.dc:creator: Lauren Sommer

item.title: Deadlocked again? U.N. climate talks in Turkey go into overtime
item.description: United Nations climate talks are heading into super overtime this weekend in Turkey. Negotiations were supposed to wrap up Friday but talks have spilled into a second night.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Waldholz
